💎 Crystal of the Month: LABRADORITE

🌈 Oh my goodness, labradorite has been speaking to me SO loudly this month. If you haven't worked with this stone yet, PLEASE listen to the universe calling you to it.

Labradorite is the stone of transformation, protection, and awakening intuition. Its iridescent flash — called labradorescence — is said to be a piece of the northern lights trapped inside the earth. The Inuit people believed these stones were pieces of the frozen fire of the aurora borealis.

Properties: Strengthens psychic abilities · Protects the aura from energy vampires · Helps you see through illusion and propaganda · Especially powerful for those who feel overwhelmed by the noise of the modern world (so — all of us, right now 😅)

Celeste's tip: Hold your labradorite when you're scrolling through news or social media. It creates an energetic buffer between your auric field and the chaotic frequencies of the internet. Honestly I cannot go online without mine anymore.

📓 From Celeste's Journal — June 18th

Woke up at 3:33 AM again. The veil is thin right now — I've been tracking this on my energy calendar and there is definitely a pattern forming around this date every year.

I've been meditating with a large piece of Nuummite (the sorcerer's stone) and receiving these very historical images — battles, smoke, a man in a grey coat on a white horse looking very certain of himself and then... not. The stone kept showing me the same scene: an eagle crest pressed into mud. Make of that what you will. I'm choosing to interpret it as a message about hubris and the limits of earthly power.

On a lighter note: my etsy shop orders have been WILD this week. I think a lot of people are feeling the chaos energies and reaching for stones. That's good. That's the right instinct. Sold out of all my shungite within two days — restocking next week.

Also — I keep seeing the word "WATERLOO" in my automatic writing sessions and I'm not sure if that's a place, a metaphor, or a song. Might be an ABBA thing honestly lol. Anyway the crystals are busy 😂✨

with love & moonlight, ~Celeste 💜
